description: This file defines a React functional component 'VectorStoreManagement' written in TypeScript with JSX syntax. It manages vector stores including listing, viewing details, creating, editing, and deleting vector stores, with associated UI elements and API calls.

methods.name: fetchVectorStores
methods.description: Fetches the list of vector stores from the backend API and updates state.

methods.name: fetchCredentials
methods.description: Fetches credentials from the backend API and updates state.

methods.name: handleRefreshClick
methods.description: Triggers fetching of vector stores and credentials, updates the last refreshed timestamp.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Prepares to delete a specified vector store by opening confirmation modal.

methods.name: handleView
methods.description: Sets the specified vector store for detailed view.

methods.name: handleEdit
methods.description: Prepares the specified vector store for editing.

methods.name: handleCloseInfo
methods.description: Closes the vector store info view and refreshes the list.

methods.name: confirmDelete
methods.description: Confirms deletion of a vector store, calls API, and handles UI updates and notifications.

methods.name: handleCreateSuccess
methods.description: Handles success callback for creating a new vector store, refreshes list.
